intro.title: Project Scaffold
intro.body: In this lesson, you'll build a basic Angular project scaffold from scratch. You'll learn how to use the Angular CLI to generate the foundational structure of an Angular application. The core concept involves understanding Angular's modular architecture and how components fit together. You'll work with key technologies like TypeScript, Angular modules, and component templates. By the end, you'll have a working Angular application ready for further development.
intro.usecase: Every Angular application starts with a proper project scaffold - from enterprise dashboards like Salesforce's analytics interface to e-commerce platforms like Shopify's admin panel. Developers use the Angular CLI to generate the foundational structure with components, modules, and services organized in a maintainable way. This scaffold ensures consistent architecture across teams, enabling features like user management systems, product catalogs, and real-time data displays to be built efficiently. Setting up the project correctly from the beginning prevents technical debt and makes it easier to add features like authentication flows, API integrations, and responsive layouts later.
